# <span id="aanchor243"></span> State Editor

The State Editor allows you to enter state names that you can then access in areas throughout FLOWCAL, such as the Meter Editor and Location Editor.

<div class="procedure">

To access the State Editor and modify state options:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.
2.  Select **State Editor** in the **Geographic** group.
3.  Select a state from the list and click the **Edit** button.
4.  Update the state data at the bottom of the screen as needed.
5.  Click the **Save** button.

To create a new state:

1.  Click the **New** button.
2.  Enter the state data at the bottom of the screen.
3.  Click the **Save** button. The state will now be available within FLOWCAL.
